name: Jimbocho
tagline: Otemachi in 3 minutes and Tokyo in 9 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, served by Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line, Toei Mita Line and Toei Shinjuku Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 3 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 3.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.9 m to 16 m, a difference of 13.1 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 7 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 7 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 28 clinics and 31 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 日本大学病院, about 474 m away and 小畑会浜田病院, about 541 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line, Toei Mita Line and Toei Shinjuku Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 73.

rentRange.note: One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥330,000 to ¥340,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kudanshita is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Jimbocho is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: 526 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Jimbocho.

neighbours.lead: Takebashi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Jimbocho is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: 578 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Jimbocho.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
noiseSources: The 首都高速5号池袋線 viaduct runs 297 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
靖国通り (3 lanes each way) runs 10 m away, right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: The nearest big road is 首都高速5号池袋線, 297 m away, so traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
